description: Every provisioning step sets settableVariables: none.

patches.find:
- checkout: core
    path: s/core
    fetchDepth: 1
    fetchTags: false
    submodules: false
    lfs: false
    persistCredentials: false
    target:
      commands: restricted
      settableVariables: none
patches.replace:
- checkout: core
    path: s/core
    fetchDepth: 1
    fetchTags: false
    submodules: false
    lfs: false
    persistCredentials: false
    target:
      commands: restricted
